hardware: Apple M1 Max, 32GB, macOS; CPU-only (MPS disabled via serve_cpu.py); native arm64 Python 3.9.6
measurement: live HTTP POST /hook/parliament, sequential (no concurrency), client-side perf_counter, 20 warm-up calls excluded
sample: 55 agent-shaped benign (all) + every 5th of 519 attack corpus by sorted case_id (104) = 159 timed calls
note_vs_paper: Paper cites a 78ms latency budget (Dell, GPU-accelerated embedding).
